newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT-India off in slow trade after local dip.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT-India off in slow trade after local dip.

text.p: Indian global depositary receipts ended slightly easier in quiet Wednesday trade, after local Indian stocks dipped earlier, traders said.
They said the market continued to struggle for clear direction and was unlikely to show much change in the near term.
Tobacco group ITC was steady despite losses in Bombay related to annual results released on Tuesday. The GDR fell late on Tuesday, after results were released.
Traders said GDRs would not rise much without gains in Bombay as they were already trading at relatively high premiums to local stocks.
The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index closed 0.42 points down at 80.07, with the premium over the local market at 23.83 percent from 23.36 percent.
SBI shed 23 cents to $24.62/25.62, ITC was six cents up at $14.00/15.00, and Hindalco lost 1.25 cents to $31.00/32.00.
The Capel Taiwan GDR Index lost 2.4 points, or 2.11 percent, to 111.23, representing a discount to the local market of 3.24 percent.
The Capel Korea GDR Index lost 0.66 points to 67.60 points, a premium of 35.91 percent over the local market.
